literal: Daozong, Part Two
idiomatic: Daozong, Part Two

literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Duck River.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

literal: Second month, halted at Nage Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

literal: Third month, on wushen new moon, Prince of Chu Xiao Ge retired and was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the third month Prince of Chu Xiao Ge retired and was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

literal: Summer, fifth month, Wuduwan tiyin Tutugu and others begged yearly tribute of horses and camels; permitted.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month Wuduwan tiyin Tutugu and others begged yearly tribute of horses and camels; permission was granted.

literal: Sixth month, on bingzi new moon, halted at Tuogulie.
idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the sixth month the court halted at Tuogulie.

literal: On xinchou day Right yilibi Xima Liu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Right yilibi Xima Liu was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

literal: That month, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Wang Ding and ninety-three others were passed.
idiomatic: That month, at the Cool Hall the jinshi Wang Ding and ninety-three others were passed.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, shot a bear at Waisila.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the seventh autumn month a bear was shot at Waisila.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu new moon, halted at Dulujin.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Dulujin.

literal: Twelfth month, on gengchen day, Yelü Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the twelfth month Yelü Tuguci, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: On guimao day visited the Western Capital.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court visited the Western Capital.

literal: On wuzi day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, partial amnesty for prisoners at the Western Capital.
idiomatic: On wuzi day, because the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth ritual, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners at the Western Capital.

literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, visited Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court visited Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: On xinwei day forbidden the people to sell copper.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the people were forbidden to sell copper.

literal: Third month, on xinwei day Song ruler Zhen died; his nephew Shu succeeded as adopted son and took the throne.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the third month Song ruler Zhen died; his nephew Shu succeeded as adopted son and took the throne.

literal: Summer, fifth month, on bingwu day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Xu.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the fifth summer month Prince of Sui Renxian was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Xu.

literal: That month, summered at Helibie.
idiomatic: That month the court summered at Helibie.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, went to Crown Prince Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Crown Prince Mountain.

literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

literal: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.
idiomatic: At the time Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Xu Renxian, Yelü Yixin who administered Northern Privy Council affairs, Southern Court chancellor Xiao Tanggu, Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu, Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Weixin, Dunmu Palace commissioner Yelü Liang, and others led several thousand night-guard troops to resist.

literal: Nielugu leaped his horse forward and was about to fight when he was shot and killed by attendant detail-stable Bohai Asi and guard Su.
idiomatic: Nielugu leaped his horse forward and was about to fight when he was shot and killed by attendant detail-stable Bohai Asi and guard Su.

literal: On jiwei day the families of the rebel party were exterminated by clan.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the families of the rebel party were exterminated by clan.

literal: On gengshen day Chongyuan fled into the great desert and killed himself.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Chongyuan fled into the great desert and killed himself.

literal: On xinyou day edict instructed all routes.
idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict instructed all routes.

literal: On renxu day Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner, advanced to Prince of Song and honored as imperial father; Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Hanjianu Palace Front commander and enfeoffed Prince of Jing.
idiomatic: On renxu day Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner, advanced to Prince of Song and honored as imperial father; Yelü Yixin was made Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Hanjianu was made Palace Front commander and enfeoffed Prince of Jing.

literal: Xiao Weixin and Yelü Fengjianu were both promoted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
idiomatic: Xiao Weixin and Yelü Fengjianu were both promoted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

literal: Night-guard officials Xiao Yixin, Uighur Hailin, Li, Yelü Tabuye, Asi, palace division men Jilige, Xiamo, Yixin, Zhilu were all promoted upper generals.
idiomatic: Night-guard officials Xiao Yixin, Uighur Hailin, Li, Yelü Tabuye, Asi, palace division men Jilige, Xiamo, Yixin, and Zhilu were all promoted upper generals.

literal: More than three hundred guards, soldiers, cooks, crossbowmen, umbrella-bearers, and the like each received office by degree.
idiomatic: More than three hundred guards, soldiers, cooks, crossbowmen, umbrella-bearers, and the like each received office by degree.

literal: Yelü Liang had secretly reported Chongyuan's plot; ordered the horizontal-account yilijin houses registered; made Han mobile palace deployment director.
idiomatic: Yelü Liang had secretly reported Chongyuan's plot; the horizontal-account yilijin houses were ordered registered; he was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

literal: On guihai day Tiebu pleaded that he had been coerced by Chongyuan and the others; edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner, exiled to Zhen Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guihai day Tiebu pleaded that he had been coerced by Chongyuan and the others; an edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner, exiled to Zhen Prefecture.

literal: On wuchen day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to Heaven.
idiomatic: On wuchen day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to Heaven.

literal: Eighth month, on gengwu new moon, dispatched envoys to reassure officials and people at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the eighth month envoys were dispatched to reassure officials and people at Nanjing.

literal: On guiyou day Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Tabuye, for merit in quelling disorder, was made associate commander of the Inspection Office.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Yongxing Palace commissioner Yelü Tabuye, for merit in quelling disorder, was made associate commander of the Inspection Office.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen new moon, visited Xingwang Temple.
idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Xingwang Temple.

literal: On gengwu day Six Courts grand guardian Yelü Heshu was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Six Courts grand guardian Yelü Heshu was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs.

literal: That month halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: That month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou day Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Jiuge was made Northern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the eleventh month Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Jiuge was made Northern Court chancellor.

literal: On jiwei day posthumously enfeoffed the late Prince of Fuchun Yelü Yixian as Prince of Xu.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the late Prince of Fuchun Yelü Yixian was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Xu.

literal: That year the imperial son Jun was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.
idiomatic: That year the imperial son Jun was enfeoffed Prince of Liang.

literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on jihai day, traveled north.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, on jihai day of the first spring month the court traveled north.

literal: Second month, forbidden Nanjing people to breach dikes to plant glutinous rice.
idiomatic: In the second month Nanjing people were forbidden to breach dikes to plant glutinous rice.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day, edict ordered prisoners in all routes decided.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered prisoners in all routes decided.

literal: On xinsi day forbidden monks and nuns to visit the imperial halt privately, falsely declaring fortune and misfortune to take property.
idiomatic: On xinsi day monks and nuns were forbidden to visit the imperial halt privately or falsely declare fortune and misfortune to take property.

literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, visited Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.
idiomatic: On renyin day of the ninth month the court visited Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Taizong's and Muzong's temples.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen new moon, halted at the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.

literal: On wuwu day forbidden the people to print texts privately.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the people were forbidden to print texts privately.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi day, fixed regulations for officials' and commoners' clothing.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the eleventh month regulations were fixed for officials' and commoners' clothing.

literal: On xinwei day forbidden slaughter on the six fast days.
idiomatic: On xinwei day slaughter on the six fast days was forbidden.

literal: On dingchou day, edict sought missing classics from the Qianwen Pavilion and ordered Confucian ministers to collate and emend.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict sought missing classics from the Qianwen Pavilion and ordered Confucian ministers to collate and emend.

literal: On gengchen day Zhangguo Army military commissioner Han Xieshi was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Zhangguo Army military commissioner Han Xieshi was made tiyin.

literal: Edict ordered Nanjing not to manufacture imperial-colored silks privately, smuggle iron, or drink wine out of season.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Nanjing not to manufacture imperial-colored silks privately, smuggle iron, or drink wine out of season.

literal: Ordered Nanjing's Three Departments each spring and autumn to feast soldiers with official funds.
idiomatic: Nanjing's Three Departments were ordered each spring and autumn to feast soldiers with official funds.

literal: Twelfth month, on guisi day Northern Court great king Xiao Wuguini was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
idiomatic: On guisi day of the twelfth month Northern Court great king Xiao Wuguini was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

literal: That year Nanjing and the Western Capital had great harvests.
idiomatic: That year Nanjing and the Western Capital had great harvests.

literal: In the first year of Xianyong, spring, first month, on xinyou new moon, civil and military officials presented the honorific title Sagely, Cultured, Spiritually Martial, All-Achieving, Great Strategy, Broad Wisdom, Perceptive, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, Heavenly Blessing Emperor.
idiomatic: In the first year of Xianyong, on the xinyou new moon of the first spring month civil and military officials presented the honorific title Sagely, Cultured, Spiritually Martial, All-Achieving, Great Strategy, Broad Wisdom, Perceptive, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, Heavenly Blessing Emperor.

literal: The era name was changed and a general amnesty proclaimed.
idiomatic: The era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Prince of Liang Jun was invested crown prince; inner and outer officials were granted rank by degree.
idiomatic: Prince of Liang Jun was invested crown prince; inner and outer officials were granted rank by degree.

literal: On jiazi day went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: On gengyin day, edict ordered that on encountering New Year's Day, Double Fifth, and winter solstice, separate memorials congratulating the Eastern Palace were to be presented.
idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered that on New Year's Day, Double Fifth, and winter solstice, separate memorials congratulating the Eastern Palace were to be presented.

literal: Third month, on dinghai day, Yang Ji, who administered Xingzhong Prefecture, was made to administer Privy Council affairs.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month Yang Ji, who administered Xingzhong Prefecture, was made to administer Privy Council affairs.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, because Zhang Sifu, who administered Privy Council affairs, was ill, he was changed to administer Xingzhong Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month, because Zhang Sifu, who administered Privy Council affairs, was ill, he was changed to administer Xingzhong Prefecture.

literal: On gengzi day summered at Tuogulie.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the court summered at Tuogulie.

literal: Fifth month, on xinsi day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the fifth month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, because the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, officials were rewarded by degree.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month, because the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, officials were rewarded by degree.

literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day a guest star violated the Heavenly Temple.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eighth month a guest star violated the Heavenly Temple.

literal: Edict ordered all routes to prepare against bandits and strictly forbid fire.
idiomatic: An edict ordered all routes to prepare against bandits and strictly forbid fire.

literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: On dingchou day Left yilibi Zaogu was made Mengfu detail-stable.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Left yilibi Zaogu was made Mengfu detail-stable.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dinghai new moon, visited Yiwulü Mountain.
idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Yiwulü Mountain.

literal: On jihai day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a tiger; a great feast was held for ministers and each ordered to compose a poem.
idiomatic: On jihai day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a tiger; a great feast was held for ministers and each was ordered to compose a poem.

literal: Eleventh month, on renxu day there was a star like a dipper, moving retrograde, with a faint sound.
idiomatic: On renxu day of the eleventh month there was a star like a dipper, moving retrograde, with a faint sound.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiawu day Prince of Liao Renxian was made regent of Nanjing and transferred to Prince of Jin.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the twelfth month Prince of Liao Renxian was made regent of Nanjing and transferred to Prince of Jin.

literal: On xinhai day Nanjing regent Xiao Weixin was made Left yilibi.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Nanjing regent Xiao Weixin was made Left yilibi.

literal: On renzi day Mars traveled with the moon from dawn to noon.
idiomatic: On renzi day Mars traveled with the moon from dawn to noon.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on dingsi day, went to the Duck River.
idiomatic: In the second year, on dingsi day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.

literal: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.
idiomatic: Song envoy congratulating the New Year Wang Yan died; he was sent back with full rites.

literal: On guimao day visited Shanyu Marsh.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court visited Shanyu Marsh.

literal: Second month, on jiawu day, edict to Wuding Army military commissioner Yao Jingxing inquiring on the way of governance; he was appointed Southern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the second month Wuding Army military commissioner Yao Jingxing was edicted on the way of governance and appointed Southern Court privy commissioner.

literal: Third month, on xinsi day Northeast Route detail-stable Yelü Hanfunu was made Northern Court great king.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the third month Northeast Route detail-stable Yelü Hanfunu was made Northern Court great king.

literal: On renwu day a comet appeared in the west.
idiomatic: On renwu day a comet appeared in the west.

literal: Summer, fourth month, continuous rain.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month there was continuous rain.

literal: Fifth month, on yihai day, halted at Tuogulie.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the fifth month the court halted at Tuogulie.

literal: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.

literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day Uighur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the sixth month Uighur came with tribute.

literal: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Zubu came with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guichou new moon, Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Muzhe was made Northern Court chancellor; Left yilibi Xiao Weixin Southern Court privy commissioner; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Bai tiyin.
idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the seventh autumn month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Muzhe was made Northern Court chancellor; Left yilibi Xiao Weixin Southern Court privy commissioner; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Bai tiyin.

literal: On bingchen day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing retired.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Southern Court privy commissioner Yao Jingxing retired.

literal: On gengshen day reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On gengshen day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On xinyou day Jingxing resumed his former post.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Jingxing resumed his former post.

literal: On dingmao day went to Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the court went to Ousi Marsh.

literal: Because of drought that year, envoys were dispatched to relieve poor people beyond the mountains.
idiomatic: Because of drought that year, envoys were dispatched to relieve poor people beyond the mountains.

literal: Ninth month, on renzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Fu was made associate privy commissioner.
idiomatic: Associate Administrator of Affairs Han Fu was made associate privy commissioner.

literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
idiomatic: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.

literal: On wuzi day monk Shouzhi was promoted acting Minister of Works.
idiomatic: On wuzi day monk Shouzhi was promoted acting Minister of Works.

literal: On dingyou day Western Capital regent Heshu was made Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Western Capital regent Heshu was made Southern Court great king.

literal: On xinchou day Xiao Muzhe was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Xiao Muzhe was made military commissioner of Wuding Army.

literal: That year, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhang Zhen and one hundred one others were passed.
idiomatic: That year, at Yong'an Hall the jinshi Zhang Zhen and one hundred one others were passed.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on xinhai day, went to the Duck River.
idiomatic: In the third year, on xinhai day of the first spring month the court went to the Duck River.
